name: Team Squirtle: Torrential Mountain Expedition
archetype: Route travel configuration — Electric/Ground speed sweeping, Ice fortress coverage, Intimidate Fighting wallbreaking, and Levitate Ground immunity. No gym duel this chapter.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym battle this chapter. Gym duel core retained from Chapter 16 (Clair's 5v5 Rising Badge duel). All six party members train freely across Route 46 and New Bark Town, elevated to Cap 72 in route-travel configuration.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 72. Hydro Pump devastates Route 46's Graveler and Donphan. Drill Peck provides Flying STAB. Roost sustains across long route traversal.
486 BST speed sweeper. Earthquake crushes Route 46's Graveler. Discharge fries aerial Fearow and Gligar. Volt Absorb provides Electric immunity.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 71. Ice Beam and Hydro Pump provide devastating dual STAB against Route 46's Ground-type dominance.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Glare paralyzes the static Slaking for safe capture. Close Combat breaks Rock/Ground types. Intimidate weakens physical threats on switch-in.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Completely immune to Earthquake and Magnitude via Levitate — the ultimate answer to Route 46's Ground-dominated encounter table.
Colossal 160 HP tank. No gym duel restriction this chapter — full 6-member route travel. RestTalk loop provides infinite sustain.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control against wild encounters.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail for Water STAB coverage.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin for tactical versatility across route encounters.
